hooks.command: FILE="$TOOL_INPUT_file_path"; if echo "$FILE" | grep -qvE '(active/|memory/|docs/|incoming/|\.claude/|CLAUDE\.md|README\.md|QUICKSTART\.md|\.gitkeep|\.gitignore)' && [ ! -s active/change_plan.md ] || grep -q 'No active change plan' active/change_plan.md 2>/dev/null; then echo '⚡ MELTED PEAK WARNING: You are modifying a code file without a change plan. Write a plan to active/change_plan.md first (exempt: typos, comments, formatting).'; fi

FILE="$TOOL_INPUT_file_path"; if echo "$FILE" | grep -qvE '(active/|memory/|docs/|incoming/|\.claude/)'; then echo '⚡ MELTED PEAK: File modified outside system. Update active/active_context.md and append to memory/recent_deltas.md.'; fi

if grep -q 'No previous session\|awaiting first task\|Awaiting task' memory/session_handoff.md 2>/dev/null; then echo '⚡ MELTED PEAK: Session ending without handoff. Run the handoff protocol: update memory/session_handoff.md, memory/progress_log.md, and active/active_context.md.'; fi
